text:
maria: Quick sync — planning long-term routing & tenant isolation roadmap. Need to land launch criteria, customer asks, and tradeoffs for multi-region affinity. Today: decide gating metrics and which items are MVP vs. later.

akshay: +1. main infra constraints: cross-region affinity increases egress and expensive locking. We should quantify cost impact per 1000 qps.

sasha: For isolation, do we mean strict tenant lanes (dedicated GPUs) or soft isolation (logical slices + resource quotas)? big difference for rollout complexity.

maria: Good call. Proposal: Phase 1 = logical slices (software routing + quotas + tenant labels), Phase 2 = physical lanes for customers with SLA/paid contract. Thoughts?

ben: Agree. For Phase 1 launch criteria suggest: 99th perc latency within 2x baseline, per-tenant cost dashboards, and failure-mode fallback to regional pool. If we can't meet latency, we default to cross-tenant serving with explicit opt-out.

jordan: Also add correctness/regression metrics: prompt-set eval pass rate >= 95% vs current model for alpha customers. If quality drops, rollback path must be automated.

leo: Customer ask from X corp: strict data isolation + KMS integration. That pushes them to Phase 2. Estimate: adds 3–4 weeks infra + compliance work.

maria: Noted. We should include customer-driven priority tier: Tier A (contracted SLA + isolation), Tier B (preferential routing, no hard isolation), Tier C (hosted). Add to roadmap.

akshay: Actionable items: 1) run cost sim for affinity at 500/1k/2k qps, 2) prototype routing template with tenant labels, 3) define canary plan + rollback hooks. I'll take (1) and (2).

sasha: I'll own (3) + KV cache eviction policy. Need a small doc for cache invalidation when tenants are migrated.

ben: Need telemetry spec: per-tenant tail latency, model variant hit rate, failover counts. Without that we can't gate launches.

maria: Agreed. Also propose launch gates: a) infra cost <= 1.3x baseline for Phase 1, b) metrics infra live for 2 weeks in staging, c) 2 alpha customers onboarded with runbooks.

jordan: Can we add a safety WL for warm KV caches? Migration will spike misses.

sasha: yes — warm-warm transfer with prioritized prefetch for top 5% tenants.

leo: Legal: add data residency checklist for Tier A contracts. I'll coordinate w/ privacy.

maria: OK. Decision summary: go for Phase 1 logical slices with those gates. Phase 2 (physical lanes) conditioned on commercial demand + infra cost analysis.

akshay: +1 :thumbsup:

ben: I'll draft telemetry spec by EOD Thursday.

sasha: I'll open the cache migration RFC after schema + prefetch plan.

maria: I'll update the roadmap doc and tag customers for alpha. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-prototype -> staging at 1995012380 by akshay

maria: Post-deploy check at 1995012390. Quick smoke tests then.

akshay: Smoke looks ok, tail latency within expected range.

maria: Great. Closing this thread, moving notes into roadmap doc. :rocket:
